name: Emissary
description: The competitive nature of Vargr society requires skilled arbitrators to settle disputes and negotiate deals. Emissaries are most often employed by governments, corporations and merchants.

arbitrator.name: Arbitrator
arbitrator.description: You work for a government and are highly skilled in settling disputes between packs and factions.

diplomat.name: Diplomat
diplomat.description: You specialise in creating and maintaining diplomatic relations with other races.

negotiator.name: Negotiator
negotiator.description: You are trained to negotiate trade deals, working for government or corporate interests.

mishaps.1: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.2: Your failed negotiations earn you a bad reputation. You are forced out of your position and lose SOC −1.
mishaps.3: You are outclassed by another Emissary. Gain them as a Rival and roll SOC 6+ to avoid losing SOC −1 in the fallout.
mishaps.4: Failed dealings force your pack to look for new leadership. Roll SOC 8+ to support the winning side. If you fail, suffer DM-2 to your next Survival roll.
mishaps.5: An assassin attempts to take your life. Roll END or Melee (Infighting) 8+. If you fail, roll on the Injury table. If you succeed, you may continue this career.
mishaps.6: An opposing Emissary attempts to humiliate you. Roll Broker, Diplomat or Persuade 10+ to outmanoeuvre them. If you succeed, you may continue in this career and gain them as a Rival. If you fail, you are forced out of your position and gain them as an Enemy.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table, but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: Negotiations are going badly. You can either cut your losses and lose SOC −1, or roll Broker, Diplomat or Persuade 10+. If you fail, you lose SOC −1, one Benefit roll from this career and suffer DM-2 to your next Advancement roll. If you succeed, gain SOC +1 and DM+2 to your next Advancement roll.
events.4: You successfully negotiate a difficult situation and are rewarded. Gain DM+1 to one Benefit roll.
events.5: Through your many dealings and negotiations you have met many influential people. Roll SOC 8+ to gain an Ally. If you fail, you gain a Contact instead.
events.6: You are given advanced training. Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill you are eligible for in this career.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Vargr Life Events table.
events.8: Your dedication and diligence to your career earns you one of Advocate 1, Broker 1 or Diplomat 1.
events.9: During high-stakes negotiations, a charismatic pack leader from the opposing side offers you a lucrative deal to switch sides. If you accept, gain one Benefit roll and your previous employer becomes a Rival. If you refuse, your current employer becomes an Ally and you gain DM+2 to your next Survival roll.
events.10: Your continued success has earned you much respect from your pack. Roll SOC 10+ to become pack leader and gain an automatic promotion.
events.11: Your successful career has placed you in a favourable position. Gain one Benefit roll or DM+4 to your next Advancement roll.
events.12: You have done exemplary work for your pack and organisation. Gain an automatic promotion and SOC +1.
